onboarding.placeDescription: Tap an agent, ability, or icon in the sidebar, then tap the map to place it. You can also drag it onto the map.
onboarding.zoomDescription: Pinch with two fingers to zoom and drag the map to pan. Use the floating +/−/Fit controls for precise edits.
onboarding.actionsDescription: Long-press an item on the map to duplicate it, switch teams, swap abilities, or delete it. You can also drag it to the trash zone.
onboarding.toolbarDescription: Use the bottom bar for undo/redo, draw, erase, delete, and recenter. The buttons at each end open the tools and agents sidebars.

tour.welcomeDescription: This is your strategy canvas where you can create tactical plans for VALORANT.
tour.agentDescription: Click on Brimstone to select him and see his abilities. You can then click on the canvas to place him or drag him directly onto the canvas in the next step.
tour.placeDescription:
Now place Brimstone by clicking on the canvas or by dragging him from the sidebar and releasing over the map. You can drag agents to reposition them after placing.

Delete an agent by dragging them to the trash can or press E while hovering over them.

When you're ready, click Next to continue.
tour.mapDescription: Click this button to select from all VALORANT maps to plan your strategies. You can explore the map options after this tour.
tour.rotationDescription: Click this button to rotate the side of the map and choose between attack and defense.
tour.phasesDescription:
Build your strategy step by step using phases. Each phase can have the same agents and abilities placed at different places to represent different steps of your strategy.

Use keyboard shortcuts A and D to quickly navigate between phases.
tour.toolsDescription:
Use these tools to draw lines, add text, shapes and more to your strategy as needed.

Feel free to experiment after this tour!
tour.saveDescription:
Save your strategies so you can come back to them anytime. Keep everything organized with folders.

Creating an account is required to save strategies.
tour.iconsDescription:
Add icons such as the Spike or weapons.

Drag icons from the sidebar and drop them onto the map like agents and abilities.

You can also click on the icon and it will be placed on the map.

tabs.aboutContent:
ValoMapper is a website that allows you to create and share strategies and executes for VALORANT.

We give you a clean canvas to map out setups, routes, lineups, and site executes without dealing with cluttered screenshots or scattered notes.

It's designed to be simple and practical. Draw your plan, share it, and refer to it in game. You can even create folders to organize your strategies and easily switch between them.

Whether you're coordinating with a team or organizing your own ideas, ValoMapper keeps everything in one place.

ValoMapper isn't endorsed by Riot Games and doesn't reflect the views or opinions of Riot Games or anyone officially involved in producing or managing Riot Games properties. Riot Games, and all associated properties are trademarks or registered trademarks of Riot Games, Inc.
tabs.lobbiesContent:
Each lobby is a shareable strategy board with its own unique URL.

You can share the URL or code with teammates or friends. Anyone with the lobby link can view and edit the strategies inside.

Lobby canvases sync automatically after every change is made. This keeps your current layout, drawings, and notes preserved across page refreshes.

You can also save lobbies to your account to easily access them later and organize them into folders as strategies. Saved lobbies won't be deleted during routine cleanups.

Free tier users are limited to 1 saved lobby per account with no folder organization. Premium users can have unlimited saved lobbies and folder organization.

Unsaved or 'unclaimed' lobbies (lobbies without an active account owner) are subject to automatic cleanup approximately every 12 hours, so make sure to save any lobbies you want to keep!
